dedupe_keys.name: utility networks from the university of cincinnati bellingham fairfield north penn and harrisburg boccelli

description: Four US utility distribution networks were contributed by Dominic Boccelli of the University of Cincinnati as entries 22 to 25 of the Water Distribution System Research Database: Bellingham, Washington (Dakin Yew Zone), Fairfield, California (Rancho Solano Zone 3), the North Penn Water Authority system in Pennsylvania, and Harrisburg, Pennsylvania (Oberlin). Each entry page offers one zip with the EPANET input file, and DataCite lists DOIs labelled WA1, CA1, PA1 and PA2. The pages give no system description, and the summary spreadsheet gives no counts, so the size, elevation and demand detail have to be read from the files. Coverage is one utility zone each, all in the United States; no dates are stated beyond the 2016 deposit. The files are free to download, and the pages state no licence, only a copyright notice of the hosting institute. Only the index page, the entry pages, the summary spreadsheet and DataCite metadata were read; no network file was downloaded or run. The networks suit hydraulic and water-quality simulation, model reduction and resilience studies on real utility layouts, though skeletonisation and anonymisation are not documented. Related records: EPANET and the database record.
